info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of Financial Engineering and Actuarial Science

description.describe_ch: 介紹財務工程與衍生性金融商品基本理論與在資產定價、風險管理、交易與投資等金融領域的應用。課程內容含括衍生性金融商品理論與評價、二元樹模型、BS選擇權評價模型、蒙地卡羅模擬法、新奇選擇權、財務風險管理、風險值與預期短缺、交易資訊內涵、財務資料分析等。運用程式軟體與金融數據資料實作練習，以提升金融計算能力，瞭解財務工程理論與相關應用。
description.describe_eh: This course provides an introduction of financial engineering and financial derivatives. Their applications in asset pricing, risk management, trading and investment will also be introduced. The topics include asset pricing, binominal trees, BS model, Monte Carlo simulation, exotic options, financial risk management, VaR, expected shortfall, and financial data analysis. Practice using programming and financial data to enhance financial computing and analysis power.
